call_points.text: Existing customers drove ₹1,195 Mn of the ₹1,857 Mn YoY increase; new customers added ₹662 Mn.
DSO rose to 79 days in Q1FY27 from 76 days in Q4FY26.
CPaaS industry growing 8-10%; Tanla expects to grow more than 10% a year.
Capex to continue at ₹100-150 Cr per annum.
Third ATP bank deal (Bandhan Bank) went live last month; billed one month in Q4.
ValueFirst UAE stuck at RBI for almost three years; management now commits to close this quarter.
UAE business top line ₹150-170 Cr, gross margin ~22%, up from single digit.
No plans to list platform business overseas; focus on growing platform revenue.

penalties.authority: ADIT (INT TAXN)-2, HYD of the Income Tax Department
penalties.details: The Company has received a Demand Notice under Section 156 of the Income-Tax Act, 1961 for assessment year 2020-21. The demand, amounting to Rs. 46,90,26,230/- (inclusive of interest), pertains to the alleged non-withholding or short-withholding of TDS on the asset-purchase consideration.
penalties.impact: Based on assessment of facts and prevailing legal position, the Company believes that it has adequate legal and factual grounds to contest the same and is taking necessary steps to protect its interest. Pursuant to the terms of the Share/Asset Purchase Agreement (SPA), any liability arising on account of future claims by the Income Tax Department relating to withholding tax on the purchase consideration is contractually borne by the Seller. Accordingly, the Company does not expect any material financial or operational impact.

operating_notes.text: Digital Platform segment revenue was ₹395 Cr in FY26, single-digit growth despite Wisely AI investment.
OTT channel run rate is about ₹1,000 Cr and OTT share of revenue held at 31-32% for four quarters.
ValueFirst UAE business has annual top line of ₹150-170 Cr and gross margin of about 22%.
Revenue from customers with annualised revenue above ₹10 Mn grew 4.5% QoQ and 16.7% YoY to ₹11,805 Mn.
Total customer count was 353 in Q1FY27 versus 326 a year ago; 13 of last year's top 20 remain in the top 20.
DSO was 79 days in Q1FY27 against 76 days in Q4FY26.

timeline.summary: On 27 April 2026 Tanla's Q4FY26 earnings call gave no FY27 guidance, disclosed Bandhan Bank as the third ATP bank live and committed to closing the ValueFirst UAE transfer this quarter.
On 22 July 2026 Tanla reported Q1FY27 revenue of ₹1,226 Cr (up 17.8% YoY) and PAT of ₹142 Cr (up 20.1% YoY), its fifth consecutive quarter of revenue growth, with FCF at 89% of PAT.
